        self._token_window.append({"ts": now, "tokens": tokens})

        self._request_window = [ts for ts in self._request_window if ts > cutoff]

            if total_tokens >= self.tpm_limit:

                return max(0.0, oldest["ts"] + 60.0 - time.monotonic())

        """

        level: Optional[AlertLevel] = None

            level = "exceeded"
        elif ratio >= 0.95:
            level = "critical"
        elif ratio >= 0.80:
            level = "warning"
        elif ratio >= 0.50:
            level = "info"

        if level is None:
            return None

        last_idx = LEVEL_ORDER.index(self._last_alert_level) if self._last_alert_level else -1
        current_idx = LEVEL_ORDER.index(level)

        if current_idx <= last_idx:
            return None

        self._last_alert_level = level

        percent = f"{ratio * 100:.0f}"
        cost_str = f"${current_cost:.4f}"
        limit_str = f"${self.cost_limit:.2f}"

        messages: dict[AlertLevel, str] = {
            "info": f"成本已达配额 {percent}%（{cost_str} / {limit_str}）",
            "warning": f"⚠ 成本已达配额 {percent}%（{cost_str} / {limit_str}），请注意控制用量",
            "critical": f"⚠ 成本已达配额 {percent}%（{cost_str} / {limit_str}），即将超限！",

        }
